function.arguments: {"observation": "The cross-tabulation of `arm` vs `severity` shows a strong imbalance: the control arm has 332 mild, 106 moderate, and 21 severe cases, while the treatment arm has only 58 mild, 100 moderate, and 95 severe cases. This indicates that treatment was assigned preferentially to patients with higher baseline severity.", "implication": "The raw difference in response rates between arms is confounded by baseline severity. Since sicker patients (severe) have lower response rates regardless of treatment, comparing raw response rates would incorrectly attribute the lower response in the treatment arm to the treatment itself, when it may instead reflect the higher severity of patients who received it. Therefore, we cannot report the raw difference in proportions as a valid treatment effect without adjusting for severity."}
function.name: note_finding
